content: Bākharzī also quotes Kamāl al-Dīn Masʿūd Shirvānī of Herat comparing Jāmī with Yazdī to Yazdī's disadvantage: Yazdī's work was widely received as, and accused of being, heterodox and deviant (the accusers bearing responsibility for their charge), whereas Jāmī walked the straight path of Sharīʿa and Sunna; Yazdī spent his whole life attached to the courts of rulers.
refers_to_primary: Kamāl al-Dīn Masʿūd Shirvānī, quoted in Bākharzī, Maqāmāt-i Jāmī, 106-7
